plans.title: Drawing Freedom
plans.summary: Raise the visual ceiling of a generated app by ranking display options on whether the verifier can tell they worked — not on what Docker permits.

plans.title: The Improvement Loop
plans.summary: Let a prototype be told to keep getting better, with a ratchet that reverts any iteration leaving it less green than it found it.

plans.title: Living Plans
plans.summary: Let a plan be revised, tested and handed off after it is made: answer its questions, change or re-research one topic, record what a real test showed, and emit a brief another tool can start from.

plans.title: Remove Prototyping
plans.summary: Delete everything that generates, runs or verifies an app, both front ends included, so that the surviving CLI is plan, dream, ls, rm, prune and doctor.
